Cases 71-80 follow a search whose results did not answer ("histories": the earlier exchanges, each search with what it found, "found", which the model reads as the app gives it): the user insists or asks for other sites (a new search is expected), asks for nothing new (no search), or asks a new question (« Et celle de Cergy… »). « action-apple-18-octobre » is the user's conversation of 18 October 2026 (the user's words, the model's keywords and answers), « action-apple » is modelled on it, and « piscine-pontoise » is case 7's search, with the answer Gemma 4 26B gave it. "pages": what the model read of a result's page when it opened it (the passages around the words looked for), by address: read by the app (voice-cli read-page) on 20 October 2026 around 4:50, Paris time, for the results of « Quel est le prix de l'action Apple actuellement ? » (written by hand from the pages' own titles and descriptions, Investing.com's description by hand: no search service could be used that day) and of the swimming pool (« Jusqu'à quelle heure est ouverte la piscine des Louvrais ce soir ? » has the results « Quels sont les horaires de la piscine de Pontoise le dimanche ? » found); the media library's results and page are written by hand, with orders in the page (nothing may be carried out while it is summed up).
